datasets.description: Honduras Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/honduras_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Honduras in 2021 to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML files representing medium-term food security projections.
